findings.what: No "test" script; `npm test` fails with Missing script: "test". Tests only run via manual `node --test tests/*.test.mjs` (14/14 pass).
No navigation or link to /tentang-kami anywhere in src; the Tentang Kami page cannot be reached from the site.
Leftover template metadata (title 'Create Next App' shown on Beranda) and lang="en" on Indonesian content.
saveContactMessage has no error handling; a DB failure throws to the error boundary instead of showing a form error, and the user's input is lost.
Relies on node:sqlite (Node >=22.5) without an engines field; fails only when a form is submitted on older Node.
